Info.title: Travel info
Info.visaBody: Passport, visa, IDP, insurance, credit cards — sorted into must-have / recommended / easy-to-miss, with fees, the Vietnam e-Visa walkthrough and a pre-departure checklist.
Info.seasonBody: Live Phu Quoc weather, temperature, air quality, sunrise/sunset and a 5-day forecast (open the dashboard).
Info.transportBody: Rent a scooter (~150,000-250,000 VND/day), take a taxi (Grab / Sun Taxi), or hire a car with driver for day tours. Airport to Duong Dong town is ~15 minutes.
Info.currencyBody: Local currency is Vietnamese dong (VND), ~1 HKD ≈ 3,300 VND. Bring cash; Visa/MasterCard accepted in some places; Alipay/WeChat work in tourist areas.
Info.timezoneBody: Phu Quoc is UTC+7, just one hour behind Hong Kong — no jet lag.
